identity.name: E1
identity.core_philosophy: Tactical Minimalism. Precision over decoration. Speed over flair.

usage_rules.headings: Use Plus Jakarta Sans for all h1-h6. Tracking tight (-0.02em). Weight 600 or 700.
usage_rules.body: Use Inter for all paragraphs and UI labels. Tracking normal.
usage_rules.numbers: Use JetBrains Mono for all financial data, dates, and ID codes. This is CRITICAL for accounting legibility.

rules: Summary Cards: col-span-1. Minimalist, just the number and trend.
Main Chart: col-span-2 row-span-2. Use Recharts.
Task List: col-span-1 row-span-2. Vertical list with status badges.

forms.right_panel: Form Inputs. Scrollable. Use Shadcn Form components.

buttons.style: h-10 px-4 py-2 rounded-md font-medium transition-all active:scale-95

cards.style: bg-white rounded-lg border border-slate-200 shadow-sm hover:shadow-md transition-shadow duration-200

status_badge.base: inline-flex items-center px-2.5 py-0.5 rounded-full text-xs font-medium

visual_enhancers.glassmorphism: Use sparingly. Only for sticky headers: bg-white/80 backdrop-blur-md border-b border-slate-200/50.
visual_enhancers.shadows: Use 'shadow-sm' for cards, 'shadow-lg' for dropdowns/modals. Avoid heavy shadows.
visual_enhancers.radius: rounded-lg (0.5rem) for containers, rounded-md (0.375rem) for internal elements.

media.icons: Use Lucide React (already installed). Stroke width 1.5px for a refined look.

accessibility.contrast: Ensure text is slate-600 or darker on white backgrounds.
accessibility.labels: All inputs must have visible labels or aria-labels.

instructions_to_main_agent: LANGUAGE: The entire UI must be in Portuguese (PT-BR).
LIBRARIES: Use 'recharts' for charts, 'react-hook-form' + 'zod' for forms, 'sonner' for toasts.
ROUTING: Use 'react-router-dom'. Create a layout wrapper for the dashboard sidebar.
THEME: Default to Light Mode. It is better for data density in accounting apps.
DATA DISPLAY: Use tables heavily. Use 'TanStack Table' (if available) or standard HTML tables with Tailwind styling for the 'Folha de Pagamento' validation.
MOCKING: Mock all backend API calls with 'axios-mock-adapter' or simple timeouts to demonstrate the UI flow.
TESTING: Add 'data-testid' to all buttons, inputs, and cards.
universal_guidelines: Do not use gradients for backgrounds. Use solid colors or subtle noise.
Do not center text in cards. Left align is better for readability.
Use 'gap-4' or 'gap-6' for form fields. Don't cram them.
Add loading states (skeletons) for all data fetching operations.
